title: Dana
details: Now this is the weirdest circumstance that has ever happened to me in porn. 2 years ago, we filmed a girl named Theresa. Shortly there after, Theresa's family found the video and all hell broke loose. The mom kicked Theresa out of the house, and worse, made the poor father watch his daughter perform sexual acts by literally making him watch the movie. Dana is Theresa's sister. Dana seen the video too. She knew exactly how extreme it was and knew the grief it caused her family, and despite all of that, she searched our number and called us to do a video. I can't stress to you enough that there are women who are so into this stuff, and if this isn't proof positive, I don't know what to say. At the end of the video Dana says, "Mom, please don't make daddy watch this." "I love you daddy." Now this is a family who can use a little therapy. I should at least get the dad a fruit basket or something.
